prompt: Write a one-star review of the Eiffel Tower from an American who has seen the one in Las Vegas.
response:
# ★☆☆☆☆ Total Ripoff — Vegas Did It Better

**Reviewed by BigMike_USA1776**

Look, I don't leave bad reviews often, but I feel like I have to warn people. My wife and I flew NINE HOURS to Paris (the one in France, not Texas) to see the "real" Eiffel Tower, and honestly? Save your money and go to Las Vegas instead.

First of all, the one in Vegas is conveniently located RIGHT ON THE STRIP. This one? You have to navigate a whole foreign city where nobody puts ice in your drinks and the portions are tiny. We walked forever and my feet still hurt.

Second, the Vegas Eiffel Tower has a Gordon Ramsay Steak restaurant at the bottom AND you can walk straight into a casino afterward. The Paris one just has... grass? And a bunch of guys trying to sell me tiny keychains. There wasn't a single slot machine in sight. What am I supposed to do after looking at it, just LOOK at it more??

Third — and nobody talks about this — the real one is honestly TOO BIG. You can't even get the whole thing in a selfie without laying on the ground. The Vegas one is half the size, which is frankly the correct size. Whoever designed this one clearly overdid it.

Also everything was in French. At the ACTUAL Eiffel Tower. You'd think for a world-famous tourist attraction they'd accommodate Americans, but no. I said "howdy" to three separate employees and got nothing.

Oh, and it "sparkles" at night for like five minutes. Cool, I guess? The Vegas one is next to the Bellagio fountains which do a whole show synced to Celine Dion. No contest.

The only good part was the crepe stand, but guess what — they have crepes in Vegas too. And a buffet.

Bottom line: Paris built a knockoff of a perfectly good Las Vegas landmark and somehow made it worse. One star. Would not fly nine hours again.
